_comment: PROBE_SET_VERSION -> fingerprint of the probe set it names (tests/probe_set_fingerprint.py). Append a stamp whenever the probe set changes; never reuse a recorded one. On 2026-10-30 the report_accounting component was dropped from the fingerprint and every recorded fingerprint recomputed from its other recorded components. 'withdrawn' lists stamps issued for an unchanged probe set; they are not current-stamp candidates. Stamps before 2026.10.30.1 used the old date-only scheme and are listed in CHANGELOG.md, not here.

2026.10.30.1.changed: 2026-10-30, commit f1d4fb3 (client_secret_basic at the token endpoint and revocation; shipped on the branch as 2026.11.03)

2026.10.30.2.changed: 2026-10-30, fix: [DEBUG] lines behind --verbose (token-cache-control debug print gated; no verdict changed)

2026.10.30.3.changed: 2026-10-30, fix: Elapsed Time excludes the attended --acquire-token stdin wait (ATTENDED_WAIT_SECONDS); no verdict changed

2026.10.30.4.changed: 2026-10-30, refactor: _apply_client_secret is the one place the token exchange, token-cors and password-grant place the client secret; no request or verdict changed

2026.10.31.1.changed: 2026-10-31, the shared 5xx rule is applied once to every oauth probe record, so a 5xx on any probe reads NOT_OBSERVED

2026.10.31.2.changed: 2026-10-31, monolith ALLOW_PRIVATE_TARGETS defaults to false so the egress guard fails closed for callers other than main

2026.10.31.3.changed: 2026-10-31, probe 10 cross-tenant added and parked behind MCPAUTHSCAN_CROSS_TENANT so the declared set stays nine; token-cors on a plain scan now EXCLUDED naming the missing client credential instead of POSTing grant_type=invalid

2026.10.31.4.changed: 2026-10-31, jwks-keys reports NOT_OBSERVED when the JWKS endpoint cannot be fetched instead of EXCLUDED; a failed fetch is an attempt not observed, not a missing prerequisite

2026.11.01.4.changed: token-cache-control judges Cache-Control on the error response the endpoint returns, including a refused client, rather than excluding it

2026.11.01.5.changed: probe 6 password-grant takes the client the run resolved, falling back to the environment

2026.10.30.5.changed: withdrawn 2026-10-30: issued by f707170 for a report-arithmetic change (coverage denominator is testable (in_scope - EXCLUDED); JSON and printed line both from counts.coverage(); zero testable -> exit 5); same probe set as 2026.10.30.4, so any report carrying 2026.10.30.5 ran the 2026.10.30.4 probe set
